title: Psychedelic Monkey Vortex
description: A surreal night scene features a large blue and purple mandala spiral in the sky with a dripping cartoon monkey head at its center. Below, a woman in a purple and black checkered outfit stands in swirling water between two decorated shacks, one sign reading 'MIND THE MONKEY' and the other 'BEWARE OF THE GORILLA SNATCH', surrounded by purple flowers, crystals, hands emerging from water, and green mountains.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork showing a giant blue mandala spiral vortex in a black sky with a smiling dripping purple monkey head emerging from its center. Below is a body of swirling water where a woman in a purple and black checkered bodysuit stands with hands raised. Flanking her are two small decorated shacks with signs that say 'MIND THE MONKEY' and 'BEWARE OF THE GORILLA SNATCH'. Green mountains, floating crystals, hands rising from the water, and glowing purple flowers fill the foreground in a detailed illustrative style.
